answer_1.quote: We propose a new Headline Generation model namely MediaHG to generate topic-catchy and contextual harmonized headlines for vertical niche platforms to enhance the click ratio and draw users' attention.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models using standard full-length ROUGE F1 following previous works. ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L refer to the matches of unigrams, bigrams, and the longest common subsequence, respectively. BLEU: To evaluate our model more comprehensively, we also use the metric BLEU proposed by which measures word overlap between the generated text and the groundtruth.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 500 cases from the test set and ask three familiar and loyal REDBook users as annotators to score the headlines generated by BART, PEAGUSUS, and MediaHG.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation is based on 3 aspects: sentence fluency, content faithfulness, and contextual eye-catchy requirements. The rating score of each model ranges from 1 to 3, with 3 being the best.
